activity_summary: Field called from his own shop, where the shelf has had a gap for six weeks. You said the Holinshed is in daily use and in excellent health, and that the cat reads only the second volume. He let that go. Sunday is dinner, after sermon, and Jacqueline has a hen. You are to bring the comedy if the book-keeper will loose it. He will read it with the door shut, and he cannot come to hear it. The chronicle stays.

entities.name: Richard Field
entities.context: Named himself and the shop, let the cat stand, set the dinner, and asked for the comedy.
